game.title: Porapol Gaseema
game.description: A traditional team sport where players throw coconuts at each other's coconuts until all nuts on one side are broken. Popular in southern Sri Lanka during festivals.
howToPlay: Step 1: Two teams line up facing each other with piles of coconuts.
Step 2: Teams take turns throwing coconuts at the opposing team's coconuts.
Step 3: The goal is to break the opponent's coconuts.
Step 4: Each broken coconut scores points.
Step 5: Game continues until all coconuts on one side are broken.
Step 6: The winning coconut is kept in the temple as an offering.
Step 7: Requires strength and throwing accuracy.
Step 8: Draws large crowds during festivals.
Step 9: Traditional in Matara and Devundara areas.
